title: Samundar Mein Gayab Hota Mandir 😱 | Stambheshwar | Mandir Ke Rahasya 2
setting: Stambheshwar Mahadev temple at Kavi Kamboi, Jambusar, Bharuch district, Gujarat, India, on the tidal mudflats of the Gulf of Khambhat near the Mahisagar river mouth; present day
description:
Gujarat ka Stambheshwar Mahadev mandir din mein do baar samundar mein doob jaata hai — aur paani utarte hi phir bahar aa jaata hai!
Maanyata hai Kartikeya ne Tarakasur ko haraakar yahan Shivling sthapit kiya. Vigyan kehta hai: Khambhat ki khaadi ke ooche jwaar.

#stambheshwarmahadev #MandirKeRahasya #gujarat
